title: function-plotter widget params
description: Per-question configuration for the function-plotter explanatory widget. Plots y = f(x) over [xMin, xMax] using a safe in-sandbox expression evaluator.

expr.description: Math expression in `x` to plot. Supports +, -, *, /, **, parentheses, identifiers (`x`, `pi`, `e`), and function calls (`sin`, `cos`, `tan`, `asin`, `acos`, `atan`, `log`, `ln`, `log10`, `exp`, `sqrt`, `abs`, `floor`, `ceil`, `round`, `pow`, `min`, `max`).

title.description: Optional title shown above the plot.
